LumenX-is-2360-r.name: IS 2360 R
LumenX-is-2360-r.summary: Compact recessed 360° ceiling PIR motion detector with 8 m reach for hands-free, energy-saving lighting control in homes and small commercial spaces.
LumenX-is-2360-r.description: The IS 2360 R (Steinel IS 2360 DE ECO) is a flush-mounting ceiling motion detector that switches lighting on when movement is detected and off again after an adjustable delay. Its 360° infrared coverage reaches up to 8 m, making it ideal for single rooms, corridors, stairwells and washrooms. The time (8 s – 35 min) and twilight threshold (2 – 2000 lux) are set via potentiometers, and the IP54 housing suits sheltered indoor and outdoor areas.
features: 360° detection with 304 switching zones and sneak-by guard
Adjustable twilight threshold (2 – 2000 lux) and switch-off delay (8 s – 35 min)
LED-ready switching up to 1000 W
IP54 protection for sheltered indoor and outdoor use
Interconnection of multiple sensors (master/master)

LumenX-is-2360-s.name: IS 2360 S
LumenX-is-2360-s.summary: Surface-mounted 360° ceiling PIR sensor with 7 m reach and 2000 W switching capacity for reliable energy-saving lighting control.
LumenX-is-2360-s.description: The IS 2360 S (Steinel IS 2360 ECO) is a surface-mounted ceiling motion detector for porches, small rooms and transitional indoor/outdoor areas. It offers 360° detection up to 7 m, an adjustable twilight threshold of 2 – 2000 lux and a switch-off delay of 8 s – 35 min. The IP54 body switches loads up to 2000 W and supports interconnection of up to five sensors.
features: 360° detection with 664 switching zones and sneak-by guard
Adjustable twilight (2 – 2000 lux) and time (8 s – 35 min) settings
Switching up to 2000 W (resistive), LED-ready
IP54 protection for indoor and sheltered outdoor use
Interconnection of up to 5 sensors (master/master)

LumenX-light-sensor.name: Light Sensor
LumenX-light-sensor.summary: KNX photoelectric lighting controller that measures daylight with two lenses to keep interior lighting constant.
LumenX-light-sensor.description: The Light Sensor (Steinel Light Sensor DUAL) is a KNX bus device that continuously measures ambient light with two lenses — one directed and one diffuse — and controls two lighting outputs for constant-light and twilight switching. It installs flush in a ceiling or wall up to 4 m high and is configured via ETS software, a remote control or the Smart Remote. The twilight threshold is adjustable from 2 – 1000 lux with 0 – 100% light-level control.

specs.label: Function
specs.value: KNX constant-light / twilight controller (2 light outputs)

specs.label: Settings via
specs.value: ETS software, remote control, Smart Remote

features: Two lenses (directed + diffuse) for accurate daylight measurement
Constant-lighting control with 0 – 100% adjustable light level
KNX logic and two light outputs
Configured via ETS, remote control or Smart Remote

LumenX-dualtech.name: DualTech
LumenX-dualtech.summary: In-ceiling presence detector combining ultrasonic and passive-infrared sensing for 360° coverage of offices and meeting rooms.
LumenX-dualtech.description: The DualTech (Steinel Presence Control PRO DualTech) pairs a 40 kHz ultrasonic sensor with a passive-infrared sensor and a light sensor, ensuring reliable presence detection even behind partitions and out of direct sight. It provides 360° coverage with an ultrasonic reach of up to 10 m and switches loads up to 2000 W. Designed for in-ceiling mounting at 2.5 – 3.5 m, it is ideal for open-plan offices, classrooms and conference rooms.

specs.label: Reach
specs.value: Ultrasonic Ø 10 m · PIR Ø 8 m

features: Ultrasonic + PIR dual technology detects presence behind partitions
520 switching zones with sneak-by guard
Semi-/fully automatic and pushbutton/switch modes
Master/master and master/slave interconnection (up to 10 sensors)

LumenX-is-3360.name: IS 3360
LumenX-is-3360.summary: High-precision 360° in-ceiling PIR presence detector with up to 40 m reach for large indoor spaces.
LumenX-is-3360.description: The IS 3360 (Steinel Presence Control PRO IS 3360) is a flush-mounting ceiling PIR presence/motion detector with 360° detection and a tangential reach of up to 40 m. It offers high sensitivity with 1416 switching zones, a twilight threshold of 2 – 1000 lux and a switch-off delay of 5 s – 15 min. Rated for 2000 W switching, it suits warehouses, sports halls, stairwells and production areas.
features: 1416 switching zones for high-precision presence detection
Sneak-by guard and segment masking
Twilight TEACH and manual ON/OFF functions
Interconnection of up to 10 sensors

LumenX-is-3360-highbay.name: IS 3360 Highbay
LumenX-is-3360-highbay.summary: Surface-mounted 360° PIR high-bay sensor with 36 m reach for warehouses and sports halls up to 14 m high.
LumenX-is-3360-highbay.description: The IS 3360 MX Highbay is a surface-mounted PIR motion detector for high-bay areas with mounting heights of 4 – 14 m. It delivers 360° detection with a tangential reach of up to 36 m and an IP54 housing. Twilight (2 – 1000 lux) and time (5 s – 15 min) settings allow energy-saving automatic switching of up to 2000 W.
features: 1416 switching zones for precise high-bay detection
IP54 housing for dusty/industrial environments
Sneak-by guard and segment masking
Interconnection of up to 10 sensors

LumenX-is-345-highbay.name: IS 345 Highbay
LumenX-is-345-highbay.summary: Aisle-optimised 360° PIR high-bay sensor covering 30 × 4 m for racking aisles up to 16 m high.
LumenX-is-345-highbay.description: The IS 345 MX Highbay is a surface-mounted PIR motion detector with an aisle lens that produces a 30 × 4 m detection zone, ideal for racking aisles and high-bay warehouses. It mounts at 4 – 16 m, provides 360° coverage with 280 switching zones, and switches loads up to 2000 W. Twilight (2 – 1000 lux) and time (5 s – 15 min) are adjustable.
features: Aisle lens for rectangular 30 × 4 m racking-aisle coverage
280 switching zones with sneak-by guard
IP54 housing for industrial environments
Interconnection of up to 10 sensors

LumenX-dual-hf-corridor.name: Dual HF Corridor
LumenX-dual-hf-corridor.summary: In-ceiling 5.8 GHz high-frequency presence detector covering a 20 × 3 m corridor zone.
LumenX-dual-hf-corridor.description: The Dual HF Corridor (Steinel Presence Control PRO Dual HF) uses 5.8 GHz high-frequency technology that detects movement through glass, wood and stud walls, plus a light sensor for constant-lighting control. Its aisle lens produces a 20 × 3 m detection zone for corridors, with 360° coverage and a twilight threshold of 10 – 1000 lux. It is designed for in-ceiling mounting at 2.5 – 3.5 m and switches up to 2000 W.
features: 5.8 GHz detection through glass, wood and stud walls
Aisle lens for 20 × 3 m corridor coverage
Semi-/fully automatic and pushbutton/switch modes
Master/master and master/slave interconnection (up to 10 sensors)

LumenX-hf-360.name: HF 360
LumenX-hf-360.summary: In-ceiling 5.8 GHz high-frequency presence detector with 360° detection and up to 12 m reach.
LumenX-hf-360.description: The HF 360 (Steinel Presence Control PRO HF 360) is a flush-mounting ceiling presence detector using 5.8 GHz high-frequency sensing that sees through non-metallic obstructions. It offers 360° detection with a reach of up to 12 m, a twilight threshold of 10 – 1000 lux and a time setting of 30 s – 30 min. Rated IP20 for indoor use, it switches loads up to 2000 W.
features: 5.8 GHz detection through non-metallic materials

LumenX-is-2180.name: IS 2180
LumenX-is-2180.summary: Wall-mounted 180° PIR motion detector with up to 12 m reach for outdoor and entrance lighting.
LumenX-is-2180.description: The IS 2180 (Steinel IS 2180 ECO) is a surface-mounted wall/corner PIR motion detector for outdoor and entrance areas. It offers 180° detection with a reach of up to 12 m, a twilight threshold of 2 – 2000 lux and a switch-off delay of 10 s – 15 min. The IP54 housing switches up to 2000 W and provides a sneak-by guard for reliable coverage.
features: 180° detection with 504 switching zones and sneak-by guard
Adjustable twilight (2 – 2000 lux) and time (10 s – 15 min) settings
Switching up to 2000 W, LED-ready
IP54 for outdoor and entrance use

LumenX-ir-quattro-micro.name: IR Quattro Micro
LumenX-ir-quattro-micro.summary: Compact in-ceiling 360° PIR presence detector with 6 × 6 m reach and IP65 rating.
LumenX-ir-quattro-micro.description: The IR Quattro Micro (Steinel IR Quattro MICRO) is a small flush-mounting ceiling presence detector for offices, hotel rooms, care rooms and washrooms. It provides 360° detection with a reach of up to 6 × 6 m, a twilight threshold of 2 – 1000 lux and a time setting of 5 s – 60 min. Its IP65 housing allows use in damp areas, and it switches loads up to 1000 W.
features: Compact 43 mm diameter in-ceiling design
IP65 for damp areas such as washrooms
Sneak-by guard and semi-/fully automatic modes
Master/master and master/slave interconnection

LumenX-ir-quattro-hd.name: IR Quattro HD
LumenX-ir-quattro-hd.summary: High-definition 360° in-ceiling PIR presence detector with up to 20 × 20 m reach and 4800 switching zones.
LumenX-ir-quattro-hd.description: The IR Quattro HD (Steinel Presence Control PRO IR Quattro HD) is a flush-mounting ceiling PIR presence detector with 360° detection, up to 20 × 20 m reach and 4800 switching zones for fine-grained presence detection. It mounts at 2.5 – 10 m, with a twilight threshold of 10 – 1000 lux and a time setting of 30 s – 30 min. Suitable for classrooms, lecture halls, offices and car parks, it switches up to 2000 W.
features: 4800 switching zones for high-definition presence detection

Constant-lighting control function

LumenX-sensiq-s.name: Sens IQ S
LumenX-sensiq-s.summary: Smart wall-mounted 300° outdoor PIR sensor with up to 20 m reach and included remote control.
LumenX-sensiq-s.description: The Sens IQ S is a surface-mounted wall/corner PIR motion detector for outdoor and indoor use, offering 300° detection with a reach of up to 20 m. It features a twilight threshold of 2 – 1000 lux and a time setting of 5 s – 15 min, with 1360 switching zones and a sneak-by guard. Supplied with a remote control, the IP54 unit switches loads up to 2000 W.

LumenX-smart-remote.name: Smart Remote
LumenX-smart-remote.summary: IR remote control for convenient wireless configuration of Steinel Professional Line sensors.
LumenX-smart-remote.description: The Smart Remote is a handheld infrared remote for adjusting Steinel sensor settings such as twilight threshold, time delay and operating mode without ladders or tools. It is powered by two AAA batteries and works with Steinel sensors that support Smart Remote configuration, including the 3000 series and Control PRO range.

LumenX-service-remote.summary: Installer service remote for commissioning and programming Steinel Control PRO sensors.

It provides convenient access to installation and test functions during setup, complementing the Smart Remote for day-to-day settings.
